segments.speaker: Asha
segments.text: We need to finalize the checkout retry policy. The current fixed delay causes synchronized retry spikes.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: The architecture decision says full jitter with three total attempts. Platform is also building a shared retry library.

segments.speaker: Mina
segments.text: Decision: Payments will use full jitter and keep the three attempt cap. Ravi will add the jitter tests.

segments.speaker: Asha
segments.text: Open question: should we adopt the Platform library now or after the checkout release? We did not assign an owner for that investigation.

analysis.summary: Payments agreed to add full jitter while retaining the three-attempt checkout cap.

decisions.text: Use full jitter and retain three total attempts.

action_items.text: Investigate adoption of the Platform retry library.

open_questions: Adopt the Platform retry library now or after the checkout release?

segments.speaker: Neha
segments.text: The shared retry SDK will support exponential backoff, full jitter, metrics, and configurable maximum attempts.

segments.speaker: Carlos
segments.text: Payments and Orders are doing similar work. We should provide a migration guide and compare their policies.

segments.speaker: Neha
segments.text: Action item: draft the migration guide by October twentieth. Carlos owns it.

analysis.summary: Platform reviewed a shared retry SDK intended to replace duplicated retry implementations.

action_items.text: Draft the retry SDK migration guide.

segments.speaker: Vanshika
segments.text: Mobile payment queue mein network retry ke liye jitter add karna hai, but ambiguous acknowledgement ke baad payment retry nahi karenge.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: We should align the metrics with the Payments runbook and ask Platform whether their shared SDK supports mobile clients.

segments.speaker: Vanshika
segments.text: Open question: can the SDK run offline? Arjun will check, but we have no due date.

analysis.summary: Mobile discussed safe jittered retries for offline payments and possible alignment with the Platform SDK.

decisions.text: Do not retry after an ambiguous provider acknowledgement.

action_items.text: Check whether the Platform SDK supports offline mobile clients.

open_questions: Can the shared SDK run offline?
